mapper.sql: from warning_record w join student s on s.id = w.student_id join class_room c on c.id = s.class_id where c.teacher_id = #{teacherId}
and (#{filter} = 'ALL' or w.status = #{filter}) and (s.name like #{like} or s.student_no like #{like} or w.summary like #{like})
mapper.select:
select w.id, w.student_id, w.level, w.rule_code, w.summary, w.status, w.teacher_note, w.created_at, w.evidence_json, s.name as student_name, s.student_no as student_no
order by w.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select w.id, w.student_id, w.level, w.rule_code, w.summary, w.status, w.teacher_note, w.created_at, w.evidence_json, s.name as student_name, s.student_no as student_no from warning_record w join student s on s.id = w.student_id join class_room c on c.id = s.class_id where w.id = #{warningId} and c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} for update

select a.id, a.action, a.summary as note, a.created_at, coalesce(u.display_name, '教师') as actor from audit_log a left join sys_user u on u.id = a.actor_id where a.entity_type = 'warning_record' and a.entity_id = #{warningId} and a.action in ('TRIAGE', 'CLOSE') order by a.id
mapper.update: update warning_record set status = 'REVIEWED', teacher_note = #{note}, level = #{level} where id = #{warningId}
update warning_record set status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = now() where id = #{warningId}
mapper.select: select s.id from student s join class_room c on c.id = s.class_id where c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and s.status = 'ACTIVE'
select score / full_score from score_record where student_id = #{studentId} and subject = '数学' order by occurred_on desc limit 4
select count(*) from attendance_record where student_id = #{studentId} and status = 'LATE' and attendance_date >= #{since}
select count(*) from student_task st join growth_task gt on gt.id = st.task_id where st.student_id = #{studentId} and gt.due_on < #{today} and st.status <> 'COMPLETED'
select count(*) from activity_record where student_id = #{studentId} and activity_date >= #{from} and activity_date < #{to}
select count(*) from activity_record where student_id = #{studentId} and activity_date >= #{since}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into warning_record(student_id, level, rule_code, summary, evidence_json, status) values (#{studentId}, #{level}, #{ruleCode}, #{summary}, #{evidenceJson}, #{status})
